description.value: Estrella's Montreal Deli & Cafe has been a Langley institution since 2001, built around iconic Montreal smoked meat sandwiches and poutine made with locally sourced organic breads, organic cheese curds, and Canadian range-fed beef. What began as a small coffee shop has grown into a full deli offering everything from hearty breakfast paninis to classic Reubens and catering platters. Cyclists can order ahead for pickup or have items delivered, with deli items including whole briskets and sliced meats also available to take on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is an active deli/cafe at 5932 200 Street, Langley City, BC. The site confirms phone (604-539-9988), address, and that pickup/delivery ordering is available, and lists vegetarian menu items explicitly. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
